'''Bill Martinson''' was a Decipher Product Development staffer. The card [[Lieutenant Tarn Mison]] is an anagram of his name.<ref name="anagrams">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], geocities.ws. Entry: "Lieutenant Tarn Mison [Bill] Martinson Decipherian". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012174750/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Internet Archive]. Also at [https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html oocities.org] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive]) and reocities (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive]).</ref><ref name="enc32">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Star Wars CCG Collecting Encyclopedia v3.2], p. 200 (Anagrams). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Radio Free Decipher ==

Martinson and [[Tim Ellington]] were guests of host [[Carol Wisely]] on [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 1 (4 December 1998), on Star Trek CCG's Dominion expansion.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195121/https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Internet Archive]</ref> Broadcast 4 (8 January 1999) interviewed him on the Trek set after Dominion and on SWCCG Endor. Broadcasts 12–13 (April 1999) paired him with [[Jerry Darcy]] on Young Jedi and Endor.<ref name="rfd" />

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Martinson did additional design on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001) and reviewed the game while mainly working on the Star Trek CCG.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== DecipherCon 2000 ==
At [[DecipherCon 2000]] Martinson was one of the designers, with [[Tim Ellington]] and [[Evan Lorentz]], who presented the Star Trek CCG Design-a-Card seminar.<ref name="fkl1">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/reports/fkl1.html Design a Card, Any Card], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher, DecipherCon 2000 reports (2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010107220600/http://www.decipher.com:80/deciphercon/2000/reports/fkl1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Interviews ==
On ''[[Radio Free Decipher]]'' in April 1999, Martinson said [[Young Jedi]] had been in development since October 1998. He described the plan of three 140-card sets with collector features such as rarity icons, card numbers and expansion icons, and credited [[Warren Holland]] with proposing its deck-building system.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XvKFYzu0P-k&t=1045s Broadcast 13 - Radio Free Decipher (09 April, 1999): Bill Martinson, Jerry Darcy on PD (Part 2)], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 20 February 2022), at 17:25. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-XvKFYzu0P-k Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 13 transcript]].</ref> Former Decipher staffer [[Jason Winter]] recalled Martinson's design motto, "the threat is worse than the execution": printing a few counter cards per set discouraged degenerate strategies without banning cards.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=1181s Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher], Imperial Remnant, YouTube (23 November 2025), at 19:41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015165322/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher (transcript)]].</ref>
